description: If a strong array described by \(d\) hits \(C_a\), with \(a\) injective and actual supplied ordinary programs \(p,q\) computing \(a,d\), the specified ordinary program \(T_{p,q}\) returns \(\chi_{\operatorname{range}(a)}(x)\) for every \(x\). It finds \(n_a(x)\), computes the single-member maximum \(M=\max F_{n_a(x)}\), and tests \(\exists i\le M\;a(i)=x\).
